shortDescription: Create, modify, or delete a firmware baseline on OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular

options.name: baseline_description
options.description: Description for the baseline being created.

options.name: baseline_id
options.description: ID of the existing baseline. This option is mutually exclusive with I(baseline_name).

options.name: baseline_name
options.description: Name of the the baseline. This option is mutually exclusive with I(baseline_id).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: catalog_name
options.description: Name of the catalog to be associated with the baseline.

options.name: device_group_names
options.description: List of group names. This option is mutually exclusive with I(device_ids) and I(device_service_tags).

options.name: device_ids
options.description: List of device IDs. This option is mutually exclusive with I(device_service_tags) and I(device_group_names).

options.name: device_service_tags
options.description: List of device service tags. This option is mutually exclusive with I(device_ids) and I(device_group_names).

options.name: downgrade_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether firmware downgrade is allowed for the devices in the baseline. This value will be set to C(true) by default, if not provided during baseline creation.

options.name: filter_no_reboot_required
options.description: Select only components with no reboot required allows to create a firmware/driver baseline that consists of only the components of the target devices that don't require a reboot of the target devices.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: is_64_bit
options.description: Indicates if the repository contains 64-bit DUPs. This value will be set to C(true) by default, if not provided during baseline creation.

options.name: job_wait
options.description: Provides the option to wait for job completion. This option is applicable when I(state) is C(present).

options.name: job_wait_timeout
options.description: The maximum wait time of I(job_wait) in seconds. The job is tracked only for this duration. This option is applicable when I(job_wait) is C(true).

options.name: new_baseline_name
options.description: New name of the baseline.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: port
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular HTTPS port.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present) creates or modifies a baseline. C(absent) deletes an existing baseline.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise or OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
